name: Heroes' Feast

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: a gem-encrusted bowl worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

targets.description: up to twelve creatures who eat the feast

summary: A 10-minute feast (the bowl is 1,000 gp from the purse): for a day everyone who eats resists poison damage, is immune to being poisoned or frightened, has Advantage on Wisdom saves, and gains 2d10 Hit Points and maximum.
text: The feast takes an hour to eat; in the game the benefits start at once. For 24 hours each diner has Resistance to Poison damage, immunity to the Poisoned and Frightened conditions and Advantage on Wisdom saving throws, and a Hit Point maximum raised by 2d10, gaining that many Hit Points too.
